title: Footprint borders
notes: K-1 first route: Problem 1 makes one repeating border and tests matching and failing slides with a tracing copy; Problem 2 compares two shortest slides when the first action is reliable. Keep at least three or four visible repeats and the original fixed. Introduce the combined flip-and-slide only before Problems 3-4. On return, K-1 can change a matching flip (P5) or investigate half-turns and partner testing (P6-7). Grades 2-3 can choose reflection or half-turn constructions and edits (P4-6). Grades 4-5 can return to forced compositions (P3-4), or spend a visit finding all symmetries of one border (P5-6).
